## Change

Describe the user-visible or technical change and its scope.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Manual preview check when behavior or device geometry changed
- [ ] Documentation updated where behavior or limitations changed

## Public-data check

- [ ] The change contains no private URLs, screenshots, logs, credentials,
      cookies, profile contents, or employer/client code.
- [ ] New third-party code or assets include source and license information.
